scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Welcomed Mineral^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我为你准备了名为^880088受欢迎的矿石^000000的委托。
打开^990099任务窗口^000000，查看委托详情和交付对象。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
I have a request to bring in 16 Dragon's Manes.
scripts.translation: 我有一项委托，需要16根龙鬃。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
Dragon's Mane is only dropped in small volumes by the Dracos and is very valuable. It is used in our indigenous designs in our flags, clothes and field equipment.
scripts.translation: 龙鬃只有德拉科少量掉落，非常珍贵。我们的旗帜、服饰和野外装备都会用到这种本地材料。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Valuable Textile^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我为你准备了名为^880088珍贵的织物^000000的委托。
打开^990099任务窗口^000000，查看委托详情和交付对象。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
This is a request from the pub for the food of people from other worlds. They want Dragon Tails to use as a cooking ingredient for field food that can be stored extensively.
scripts.translation: 这是酒馆的委托：为来自异世界的人准备食物。他们想要龙尾，用来制作方便保存的野外料理。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
So humans like this. Please bring back 6 of them.
scripts.translation: 原来人类喜欢这种东西。请带6条回来。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Curious Meat^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我为你准备了名为^880088奇特的肉^000000的委托。
打开^990099任务窗口^000000，查看委托详情和交付对象。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
The path that goes out of the city is now a hazardous icy road because of the snow we've been getting.
scripts.translation: 最近一直下雪，出城的路结了冰，变得很危险。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
Spreading Pieces of Egg Shells will help and we need a lot of them. Around 26 or so will do.
scripts.translation: 在路上撒些碎蛋壳能防滑，所以需要不少。大约26个就够了。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Materials to Clear Snow^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我为你准备了名为^880088除雪材料^000000的委托。
打开^990099任务窗口^000000，查看委托详情和交付对象。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
The Bradium Processing Machinery emits tremendous heat when used and cannot be stabilized with any kind of water.
scripts.translation: 布拉迪姆加工机器运转时会散发出大量热量，普通的水无法为它降温。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
So we mix Crystalized Teardrops obtained from Aqua Elementals from melted snow. This is a material we need daily so please bring back 6 of them.
scripts.translation: 所以我们会把融化的雪和水元素掉落的水晶化泪滴混合使用。这是每天都要用的材料，请带6个回来。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Best Cooler Material^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我为你准备了名为^880088最佳冷却材料^000000的委托。
打开^990099任务窗口^000000，查看委托详情和交付对象。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
The Supply Manager has urgently requested paint to use on building maintenance throughout the city.
scripts.translation: 补给管理员急需油漆，用于全城建筑的维护。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
He can make enough paint by using the Fluorescent Liquid obtained from Aqua Elementals. Please bring back 26 containers of it.
scripts.translation: 用水元素掉落的荧光液体就能调制足够的油漆。请带回26份。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Best Paint^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我为你准备了名为^880088最佳油漆^000000的委托。
打开^990099任务窗口^000000，查看委托详情和交付对象。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
The valuable interior water bottle in the minister's room is broken. They won't be able to find who did it because there are so many visitors every day.
scripts.translation: 大臣房间里那只珍贵的装饰水瓶打破了。每天进出的人太多，根本查不出是谁弄坏的。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
Can you please bring me this valuable item from Aqua Elemental? I only need 1.
scripts.translation: 能帮我从水元素身上带回这种贵重物品吗？我只需要1个。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Rare Valuable^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我为你准备了名为^880088稀有珍宝^000000的委托。
打开^990099任务窗口^000000，查看委托详情和交付对象。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
Lining supplies for armor for the Guards are all out.
scripts.translation: 卫兵铠甲用的衬料已经用完了。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
The scale shell from Naga are perfect lining material. Please bring back 18 of them.
scripts.translation: 那迦的鳞片很适合做衬料。请带18片回来。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Armory Material^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我为你准备了名为^880088铠甲材料^000000的委托。
打开^990099任务窗口^000000，查看委托详情和交付对象。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
I got you a request named lining material for armor supplied to the guard commanders. They are different from ordinary lining.
scripts.translation: 卫队长的铠甲衬料和普通款不同，我这里有项委托要找这种材料。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
Please bring me 11 shining scales of Naga. I don't think it will be much trouble for you.
scripts.translation: 请带回11片那迦的闪亮鳞片。我想这对你来说不难。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Advanced Armory Material^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我为你准备了名为^880088高级铠甲材料^000000的委托。
打开^990099任务窗口^000000，查看委托详情和交付对象。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of items. Let's try again after you reduce the number of items.
scripts.translation: 物品种类太多了。请先减少物品种类，再试一次。

scripts.text: Cannot proceed because the weight of your items is too heavy. Let's try again after you get rid of some weight.
scripts.translation: 物品太重，无法继续。请先减轻负重，再试一次。
（听不懂的萨法语）

scripts.text: I don't feel confident in talking since you wouldn't understand anything.
scripts.translation: 反正你也听不懂，我不太敢跟你说。

scripts.text: Sapha keeps a distance from you even when you try to talk. Looks like he called on Guard Galten. Time to go.
scripts.translation: 即使你试着搭话，萨法族人还是和你保持距离。看来他叫来了加尔滕卫兵。该离开了。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
It is pretty embarassing that you are looking for a request with your level, you know that?
scripts.translation: 你这等级还来找委托，有点让人难为情啊，知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Calculate your request activities with the ^990099Supply Dept. 2 Manager^000000 at Operations and then come back.
scripts.translation: 先到运营部找^990099补给二部主管^000000核对委托进度，再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
I don't have any requests for you now. Report back to the ^990099Supply Dept. 2 Manager^000000 at Operations after you complete all requests.
scripts.translation: 我现在没有委托给你。完成手头所有委托后，请到运营部向^990099补给二部主管^000000汇报。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Welcome.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
欢迎。
找我有什么事？

scripts.text: Please explain the request to me.
scripts.translation: 请告诉我委托的详情。

scripts.text: Please give me a request.
scripts.translation: 请给我一项委托。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Pura will explain the detail about the supply job. I'm soooo busy as you can see.
scripts.translation: 补给工作方面的问题，普拉会给你详细说明。你看我现在忙得很。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
I just got a request. It's good that none of us wasted time.
scripts.translation: 我刚收到一项委托，正好省得我们白等了。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
It's time to repair the trumpets for Mine supervisors.
scripts.translation: 该给矿场主管们的号角做维修了。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Because those trumpets are necessary to control the miners. The mystic horn from Cornus is the perfect trumpet material, please get 5 pieces of them.
scripts.translation: 这些号角是管理矿工的必需品。飞马的魔力之角最适合做号角材料，请带5个回来。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Supervisor's Tool^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我为你准备了名为^880088主管的工具^000000的委托。
打开^990099任务窗口^000000，查看委托详情和交付对象。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
It seems that there isn't enough amount of fur which is for the adventurers.
scripts.translation: 冒险者用的毛皮似乎不够了。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
It will be necessary to get some fur from Tatacho. 21 lumps will be enough.
scripts.translation: 得从塔塔乔身上收集些毛皮。21团应该就够了。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Preparation for Heating^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我为你准备了名为^880088供暖准备^000000的委托。
打开^990099任务窗口^000000，查看委托详情和交付对象。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
There was a request from the pub to collect 27 bug legs.
scripts.translation: 酒馆委托我们收集27条虫腿。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
They don't wanna reveal the reason why they need them. Anyway, thank you.
scripts.translation: 他们不肯说要这些虫腿做什么。总之，拜托你了。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Suspicious Food^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我为你准备了名为^880088可疑的食材^000000的委托。
打开^990099任务窗口^000000，查看委托详情和交付对象。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Zargon is very popular among the residents here. It's a beautiful, round shaped ball and can be used as a adhesive when its powder is mixed with water.
scripts.translation: 刹勒空结晶在这里很受欢迎。这种圆润漂亮的结晶磨成粉后和水混合，就能当作黏合剂。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Heard that it's very common material from the adventurers' land. Would you get some? It will be enough with 26 Zargons.
scripts.translation: 听说这是冒险者大陆很常见的材料。帮我带些回来吧，26个就够了。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Useful Material^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我为你准备了名为^880088实用材料^000000的委托。
打开^990099任务窗口^000000，查看委托详情和交付对象。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
There is a request which is to find a material to be used for every quarter's building repair work.
scripts.translation: 有一项委托，需要寻找用于每季度建筑维修的材料。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Please get 13 Solid shells which can be obtained from Centipede and Centipede Larva. It will be very useful for the repair work.
scripts.translation: 请从变异蜈蚣和变异蜈蚣幼虫身上收集13块坚硬外壳，对维修工作很有用。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Essential Material for Construction^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我为你准备了名为^880088建筑必需材料^000000的委托。
打开^990099任务窗口^000000，查看委托详情和交付对象。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
There is a request which is to find a material to be used for every quarter's building repair work.
scripts.translation: 有一项委托，需要寻找用于每季度建筑维修的材料。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
You need to get 16 Strong vines which can be got from nepenthes. It's a vital material for building repair work.
scripts.translation: 从猪笼草身上收集16根结实的藤蔓。这是建筑维修的重要材料。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Essential Material for Construction 2^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我为你准备了名为^880088建筑必需材料2^000000的委托。
打开^990099任务窗口^000000，查看委托详情和交付对象。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
The guard need many sharp leaves for a decoration reason. Some other adventurers started searching them.
scripts.translation: 卫兵想要很多锋利的叶子来装饰营地，其他冒险者已经开始收集了。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
They need pretty many quantity of the leaves so they want 26 sharp leaves from you. I know it's hard. Wish you good luck!
scripts.translation: 他们需要的数量不少，想请你带26片锋利叶子回来。我知道这不容易，祝你好运！

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Decoration arrangement^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我为你准备了名为^880088装饰布置^000000的委托。
打开^990099任务窗口^000000，查看委托详情和交付对象。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
The pub owner is in trouble due to many adventurers from outside.
scripts.translation: 外地冒险者来得太多，酒馆老板忙不过来了。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
He wishes to have an utensil which can be used simply and instantly, something like a wide leaf.
scripts.translation: 他想要一种能随手取用的餐具，比如宽大的叶子。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Instant Receptacle^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我为你准备了名为^880088即用餐具^000000的委托。
打开^990099任务窗口^000000，查看委托详情和交付对象。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
There have been couple of attacks in mine. It must be those Nepenthes that were trying to attack miners.
scripts.translation: 矿场发生了几起袭击事件。一定是猪笼草在攻击矿工。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
In order to make the medicine, we need 16 brown roots. Find and bring them.
scripts.translation: 制作药物需要16根褐色树根。请找来交给我。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Not enough medicine^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我为你准备了名为^880088药材短缺^000000的委托。
打开^990099任务窗口^000000，查看委托详情和交付对象。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
The pub owner came by and blamed and blamed about the big appetite of you guys.
scripts.translation: 酒馆老板来抱怨了，说你们这些冒险者胃口太大。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
He said he has no more stock of honey and fruits. 2 jugs of honey will be enough to soothe him.
scripts.translation: 他说蜂蜜和水果都快用完了。带两罐蜂蜜回来，应该就能安抚他。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Honey robber^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我为你准备了名为^880088偷蜜贼^000000的委托。
打开^990099任务窗口^000000，查看委托详情和交付对象。

scripts.text: - You can too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Doha]
What is it?
You don't look like you have any business with me.
If you don't, please leave now.
scripts.translation:
什么事？
看起来你没有公务要找我。
如果没事，就请离开。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Who is asking?
If you are in the wrong room, please leave now.
scripts.translation:
谁要见我？
如果你走错房间了，请离开。

scripts.text: Came to meet the inspector.
scripts.translation: 我来见监察官。

scripts.text: Sorry.
scripts.translation: 抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Me?
Are you the person the captain was speaking of?
What was the name...
{0}?
scripts.translation:
我？
你就是船长提到的那个人吗？
叫什么来着……
{0}？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Hmm.. I don't know why you were chosen but I guess they trusted you enough.
I heard you were chosen to visit El Dicastes, the capital city of Sapha.
scripts.translation:
嗯……我不知道他们为何选中你，不过看来他们很信任你。
听说你被选中前往萨法首都埃尔迪卡斯特。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
I have a secret mission for you regarding this visit.
More like an order.
scripts.translation:
关于这次访问，我有项秘密任务要交给你。
准确地说，是命令。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
I'm the inspector dispatched from the home country because of the report case.
We are working on investigating the truth behind the reported case.
scripts.translation:
我是因报告失窃案而从祖国派来的监察官。
我们正在调查这起案件背后的真相。

scripts.text: Report case?
scripts.translation: 报告失窃案？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
You haven't heard of it?
I thought you already knew..
So you're not the one that collected the report back then?
scripts.translation:
你没听说过吗？我还以为你知道……
所以当时负责收集报告的人不是你？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
When the expedition was dispatched before
there was a general report on our research results on various categories
and the messenger that was carrying this report back to home country was attacked.
scripts.translation:
之前派出远征队时，我们整理了一份汇总报告，记录各领域的研究成果。
负责把报告送回祖国的信使遭到了袭击。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Luckily the report wasn't stolen completely
and we did get the report after painstakingly restoring it.
The important thing is who did this.
scripts.translation:
幸好报告没有被彻底偷走，我们费尽力气修复后还是拿到了。
现在最重要的是查出谁干的。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
As you already know the expedition here is an alliance of 3 countries.
And we aren't all in good terms.
That is why Hibba Agip was put in charge by the captain and upper management because he isn't attached to any of the countries.
scripts.translation:
如你所知，这里的远征队是三个国家组成的联盟，彼此关系并不融洽。
正因如此，船长和高层才让不隶属任何国家的希巴·阿吉普负责统筹。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
But the important thing is which country was behind this
and why would they do such a thing when we must promote peace and cooperation.
scripts.translation: 关键是查出哪个国家在幕后指使，以及他们为何要这么做。我们本该促进和平与合作才对。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
That is why I was dispatched here to investigate on.
I've come across an unexpected information during my investigation.
scripts.translation: 所以我被派来调查。调查过程中，我发现了一条意料之外的线索。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Do you know the Cat Merchant?
They are also doing business nearby.
One of the Cat Merchants
spilled this information to me.
scripts.translation:
你知道猫商人吗？他们也在附近做生意。
其中一位猫商人向我透露了这条线索。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
I was investigating at the location assumed to be where the attack took place
when I met a cat. Well.. I don't know what else I'm supposed to call them.
scripts.translation:
我正在调查推测中的袭击地点时遇到了一只猫。
嗯……我也不知道该怎么称呼他们。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
But it turns out, I was lucky to meet this cat.
Because he turned out to be a witness to the case.
scripts.translation:
不过，能遇见那只猫真是走运。
原来它是这起案件的目击者。

scripts.text: Witness!
scripts.translation: 目击者！

scripts.text: Who did it?
scripts.translation: 是谁干的？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Sigh...
He did witness the case but the description I got was...
suspicious at first.
scripts.translation:
唉……
它确实目击了案件，但它给我的描述……
一开始听起来很可疑。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Well... the cat said in his own words.
he might be one of us because he was very agile and quick.
scripts.translation:
嗯……那只猫是这么说的：
袭击者动作敏捷、身手很快，它觉得对方可能和自己是同类。

scripts.text: Same race? Cat?
scripts.translation: 同族？猫？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Yes.
I heard the cat say that with my own ears.
He said he went back to the place to see if it was a lost friend of his.
scripts.translation:
没错，我亲耳听到它这么说。
它说自己曾返回案发地点，想看看袭击者是不是走失的同伴。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Hmm... my throat is soar from talking too much.
Let's continue later after I get some rest.
I think I need a cup of water.
scripts.translation:
嗯……说太多，嗓子都哑了。
我休息一下再继续吧。
得喝杯水。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Thank you.
I'm a little tired now.
I hope to see you next time.
scripts.translation:
谢谢。我有点累了。
希望下次还能见到你。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Wow.... they say this is the water melted from the snow from the snowy fields.
Very refreshing, don't you agree?
....
scripts.translation:
哇……听说这是雪原上融化的雪水。
真清爽，你不觉得吗？
……

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Then back to the story.
So I asked why the cat thought it was his own kind.
scripts.translation:
接着说正事吧。
我问那只猫，为什么认为袭击者和它是同类。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
He said the attacker had a wonderful tail and attractive ears.
Hard to believe.
scripts.translation:
它说袭击者有一条漂亮的尾巴，还有一双惹人注目的耳朵。
真让人难以置信。

scripts.text: It was a cat?
scripts.translation: 是只猫？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
No. I asked the same question.
And he said the attacker looked more like me.
Meaning humanlike to be precise.
scripts.translation:
不是。我当时也这么问了。
它说袭击者看起来更像我——
准确地说，更像人类。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Yes. A human male.
He said ^4d4dff the attacker had attractive ears and a sleek and glossary tail^000000!
scripts.translation:
没错，是个人类男性。
它说^4d4dff袭击者有一双迷人的耳朵，还有一条光滑漂亮的尾巴^000000！

scripts.text: Could it be a hobby?
scripts.translation: 会不会只是个人爱好？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Are you talking about the Kitty Band that was popular in Prontera?
If a full grown male was wearing one of those... and also a tail?
scripts.translation:
你说的是在普隆德拉流行的猫耳发箍？
要是成年男性戴着那个……再配一条尾巴？

scripts.text: Was he in disguise?
scripts.translation: 他是在伪装吗？

scripts.text: Taste should be respected.
scripts.translation: 每个人的品味都该受到尊重。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
I agree.
I think one of the countries is behind this.
I honestly think both the Sapha and Rapine won't get anything out of this.
scripts.translation:
我也这么想。
应该有某个国家在幕后策划。
我不觉得萨法族或拉菲尼族能从中获益。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
I guess it will only be a way of hiding you are from.
Disguised as a cat, that is!
scripts.translation:
我想这只是为了隐藏他的来历。
也就是说，他伪装成了一只猫！

scripts.text:
[Doha]
....................
............Of course
different tastes should be respected.
scripts.translation:
…………
……当然，不同的品味都该受到尊重。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
....Ahem.
My conclusion is
Someone disguised themselves ridiculously in order to hide where they came from!
scripts.translation:
……咳。
我的结论是，有人为了隐藏来历，故意把自己伪装得很滑稽！

scripts.text:
[Doha]
So what we need to do now is
Finding a guy with cat ears.
But I'm not so sure he will have them on him now.
scripts.translation:
所以接下来要找一个戴着猫耳的人。
不过我不确定他现在还戴不戴。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
But as the Cat Merchant mentioned, we shouldn't rule out the possibility that he might be from a third party.
Then what could his motives be.
scripts.translation:
但正如猫商人所说，也不能排除他来自第三方势力的可能。
他的动机又会是什么？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Let's start simple before it gets too complicated.
I heard you are visiting El Dicastes, the capital city of Sapha.
scripts.translation:
先从简单的调查开始，别把事情想得太复杂。
听说你要去萨法首都埃尔迪卡斯特。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Whether it is a cat or dog
Please try to collect information on a guy with animal ears.
scripts.translation:
不管他戴的是猫耳还是狗耳，
请尽量打听那个戴动物耳朵的人的消息。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
I will continue on searching and investigating Manuk and Splendide from here.
I need you to investigate during your journey and also at El Dicastes.
scripts.translation:
我会继续调查马努克和辉煌领域。
你在旅途中，尤其是到了埃尔迪卡斯特之后，帮忙寻找线索。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
This is a very important mission.
There is a delicate conflict between the three countries
and there might be a possibility of an unknown third party.
scripts.translation:
这项任务非常重要。
三个国家之间的关系十分微妙，而且可能还有未知的第三方势力介入。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
And why did the attacker only interfered instead of stealing the whole report.
we need to the purpose.
scripts.translation:
还有，袭击者为什么只干扰报告，却没有把整份报告偷走？
我们得查明他的目的。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Please bring back some clues. Anything you come by during your journey
Please report back to me if you have anything leads.
scripts.translation: 请带回一些线索。旅途中遇到任何相关情况，都请回来告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
I will investigate Manuk and Splendide.
So you will have to look for clues in El Dicastes.
scripts.translation:
我会调查马努克和辉煌领域。
你负责在埃尔迪卡斯特寻找线索。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
About the guy with animal ears.
It will be a tough mission but I know you will do well.
scripts.translation:
关于那个戴动物耳朵的人……
这任务不简单，但我相信你能办好。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
How is the investigation going?
Please try your best.
not to break the parallel relationship between countries.
scripts.translation:
调查得怎么样了？
请尽力而为，别破坏国家之间的平衡关系。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
How is the investigation going?
Do you have any significant status?
scripts.translation:
调查有进展吗？
有什么重要发现吗？

scripts.text:
You share the details regarding Diel, Cheshire, Ahat and the crack of dimension.
You give him a clot of blood, shells and a magical stone as evidence.
scripts.translation: 你告诉道哈有关迪尔、柴郡、阿哈特和次元裂缝的情况，并把凝固的血迹、冻皮碎片和奇异魔力石交给他作为证据。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Hmm..
I actually gave the same mission to all other people heading for El Dicastes.
scripts.translation:
嗯……
我也给其他前往埃尔迪卡斯特的人安排了相同的任务。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
They have all brought information based on assumptions.
Meaning your evidences are not much different from the others.
scripts.translation:
他们带回的也都是推测性的情报。
也就是说，你的证据和其他人的差不多。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
At least we found out one thing.
At least we now know that the attacker is not from the three countries of Midgard.
But this is only an assumption.
scripts.translation:
至少我们弄清了一点：袭击者并非来自米德加尔特的三个国家。
不过，这还只是推测。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Details of the report will be verified by a superior authority and a schedule for the next step will be given.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
上级会核实报告内容，并安排下一步行动。
谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Please have this.
This is a reward for your services up to now.
You deserve this for the hardship you are going through in another world.
scripts.translation:
这个给你。
这是对你到目前为止所做工作的奖励。
你在异世界奔波辛苦，理应得到这份报酬。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
....
Sapha and Rapine, which ever.
I have something more urgent.
scripts.translation:
萨法族也好，拉菲尼族也罢……
我还有更紧急的事要处理。

scripts.text: Can you repeat that?
scripts.translation: 你能再说一遍吗？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
..? 
I didn't say a thing.
I guess you heard wrong.
Will you leave now? Because I have to organize a report.
scripts.translation:
……？
我什么也没说。你大概听错了。
现在可以离开了吗？我得整理报告。

scripts.text:
You are missing evidence to submit with your report:
Clotted Bloodstain, Piece of Frozen Skin, Strange Magic Stone.
You will have to collect the items again.
scripts.translation:
你提交报告所需的证据不齐：
凝固的血迹、冻皮碎片和奇异魔力石。
请重新收集这些物品。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
There won't be any changes to the current policy.
Home land will continue to review the contents of your reports.
[Doha]
All we can do for now is
do our best, right?
He says its kindly but his eyes have a get out and do your work kind of look.
scripts.translation:
现行政策不会改变。
祖国仍会继续审查你提交的报告。
[道哈]
我们现在能做的，就是尽力而为，对吧？
他语气客气，眼神却分明在说：“快去干活。”

scripts.text: - You can too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: [Shay]
scripts.translation: 谢伊

scripts.text:
[Shay]
.. Burman Flone.
scripts.translation: ……布尔曼·弗洛内。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What?
scripts.translation: 什么？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Boring. What is it?
scripts.translation: 真无聊。怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Sigh... Ready to order?
scripts.translation: 唉……准备好点单了吗？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Another failure?.
I'm talking to myself. Don't bother.
What do you want?
scripts.translation:
又失败了？
我在自言自语，别管我。
你想要什么？

scripts.text: Order.
scripts.translation: 点单

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 聊天

scripts.text: Never mind.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What will it be?
I have Tropical Sograt and Vermilion on the Beach flown in from Morocc.
A bit on the expensive side though.
scripts.translation:
想点什么？
我这里有从梦罗克空运来的热带苏格拉特和海滩维梅利恩，不过价格有点贵。

scripts.text: Tropical Sorgrat - 2000z
scripts.translation: 热带苏格拉特——2000 Zeny

scripts.text: Vermilion on the Beach - 2000z
scripts.translation: 海滩维梅利恩——2000 Zeny

scripts.text: Anything else?
scripts.translation: 还要点别的吗？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Here.. 
......Hmmm...
Nah.
scripts.translation:
给你……
……嗯……
算了。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Here is your {0}.
scripts.translation: 这是你的{0}。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
{0} is 2000 Zeny.
What is it so expensive?
Then you try to bring it all the way here.
scripts.translation:
{0}要2000 Zeny。
怎么这么贵？
你自己试试把它从那么远的地方运过来。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
If you haven't registered at Diel yet, you better do it soon.
That is the only way to start receiving requests and guarantee your safety here.
scripts.translation:
你要是还没在迪尔登记，最好尽快办好。
只有登记后才能开始接委托，也能确保你在这里的安全。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
To avoid conflicts apart from diplomatic trouble
it is always better to respect each sides agreement.
Don't you agree?
scripts.translation:
除了外交上的麻烦，为避免冲突，最好尊重彼此的约定。
你说呢？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Not that busy but I don't want to do it.
scripts.translation: 也不是很忙，就是不想做。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I don't want to talk about personal stuff.
But do you have any questions?
scripts.translation: 我不想聊私事，不过你有什么问题吗？

scripts.text: Tell me about yourself
scripts.translation: 说说你自己

scripts.text: About Sapha
scripts.translation: 关于萨法族

scripts.text: About other races
scripts.translation: 关于其他种族

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Me?
.If you are asking about my name, it is written on my badge here.
It's Shay.
scripts.translation:
问我吗？
如果你是问名字，看看我胸前的徽章，上面写着呢。
我叫谢伊。

scripts.text: Not that
scripts.translation: 我不是问这个。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Hmm. Then should I tell you the story on how I settled here?
The first to apply to expedite here
where the Assassins.
scripts.translation:
嗯……那我给你讲讲我是怎么在这里定居的吧。
最早申请来这里探路的，是刺客。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I was one of them.
That is how I got to reach this place before anyone else did
And that is how the base of the expedition camp was built.
scripts.translation:
我就是他们中的一员。
所以我比其他人更早来到这里，远征营地的基地也由此建成。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
But you know.
I thought I'd return to my hometown and retire.
But El Dicastes contacted me.
scripts.translation: 不过啊……我本来打算回老家退休，没想到埃尔迪卡斯特联系了我。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
They requested if I could open a place for us outsides to feel comfortable with.
They also were considerate enough to build it in Midgard style.
scripts.translation:
他们想让我开一家店，让我们这些外来者也有个舒服的落脚处。
他们还特地按照米德加尔特的风格建造，挺周到的。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
So the framework and style,
architect was brought in..
and then I found myself managing the whole project?
scripts.translation:
于是定下了店面的布局和风格，请来建筑师……
结果我莫名其妙地成了整个项目的负责人？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
And...
that is how I got here.
I've been here ever since!
scripts.translation:
然后……
我就这么留在这里了。
从那以后就一直没走！

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I don't remember what my original job was.
Little rusty on the Katar, I guess...
scripts.translation:
我都不记得自己原来做什么了。
现在用拳刃大概有点生疏了吧……

scripts.text:
Shay suddenly has a lonely expression and sighs deeply about his situation.
Looks very tired.
scripts.translation:
谢伊忽然神情落寞，深深叹了口气。
看起来疲惫极了。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Sapha?
You are surrounded by Saphas.
......
scripts.translation:
萨法族？
你周围不都是萨法族人吗？
……

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What are you asking me?
Just ask any Sapha passing by.
Ask 'what are you'.
scripts.translation:
你问我干嘛？
随便找个路过的萨法族人问问就行了。
问他们“你们是什么人”。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Other races?
Talking about Sapha?
scripts.translation:
其他种族？
你是指萨法族吗？

scripts.text: With cat ears.
scripts.translation: 长着猫耳

scripts.text: With butterfly wings.
scripts.translation: 长着蝴蝶翅膀

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Cat?
Are you talking about the Cat Merchant?
They are camped outside of the capital gate.
scripts.translation:
猫？
你说的是猫商人吗？
他们就在首都城门外扎营。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
They even mined and fished near the expedition camp.
They are currently trying to expand their business
scripts.translation:
他们甚至在远征营地附近采矿、捕鱼。
最近还在想办法扩大生意。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Well.. bigger then them?
Not sure. Haven't heard of it.
Why don't you ^4d4dffask Sapha's around here?^000000
scripts.translation:
嗯……比他们还大的？
我不清楚，没听说过。
你为什么不^4d4dff问问附近的萨法族人？^000000

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Butterfly wings? Are you talking about Rapine?
Don't know them?
You really no nothing.
scripts.translation:
蝴蝶翅膀？你说的是拉菲尼族？
你连他们都不知道？
你可真是什么都不懂啊。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
If you want to know about Rapine, go to Splendide.
They are rough and tough.
scripts.translation: 想了解拉菲尼族的话，就去辉煌领域。他们做事粗犷又强悍。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What...
I'm not that busy but don't bother me too much.
scripts.translation:
怎么了……
我是不算忙，但也别太烦我。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What is it now?
Any luck?
scripts.translation:
怎么又来了？
有进展吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm trying to organize the information I've collected.
{1}
But what should I do with the collected information?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我正在整理收集到的情报。
{1}
可这些情报接下来该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm trying to organize the information I've collected.
But what should I do with the collected information?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我正在整理收集到的情报。
可这些情报接下来该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm trying to organize the information I've collected.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我正在整理收集到的情报。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Moan...
[Shay]
You look lost like as if nothing makes sense anymore.
They solution is simply to ask around.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
唉……
[谢伊]
你看起来一脸迷茫，好像什么都理不清。
解决方法很简单：到处问问。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
There are many Saphas working at the factory, drill hall, square and anywhere else.
There are the Cat Merchants outside of the castle, too.
scripts.translation:
工厂、训练场、广场，到处都有萨法族人在工作。
城堡外还有猫商人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Everybody
is talking about the minister these days!
What is with this Ahat anyway.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
最近大家都在谈论那位大臣！
阿哈特到底怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I haven't even seen the minister.
I heard many say that he is beautiful.
scripts.translation:
我甚至没见过大臣。
不过我听很多人说他很英俊。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Anyway........
Try this.
I've been working on this for some time and hope that this can go on the menu.
scripts.translation:
总之……试试这个。
我研究了好一阵子，希望能把它加进菜单。

scripts.text:
- Shay places a baked pie with the base made out of carrots.
Topped with something that looks like apples or bananas.
You immediate think it is too risky to try. ?
scripts.translation:
- 谢伊端出一个烤派，派底是用胡萝卜做的。
上面还铺着些看起来像苹果或香蕉的东西。
你马上觉得这玩意儿还是别尝为妙。 -

scripts.text: The minced ingredient is...
scripts.translation: 里面切碎的食材是……

scripts.text:
[Shay]
An apple pie.
I garnished it with bananas.
Doesn't look like it but this is an apple pie.
scripts.translation:
苹果派。
我用香蕉装饰了一下。
虽然看不出来，但这确实是苹果派。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But why is there a carrot in a pie.
And there is no hint of apples.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
可为什么派里有胡萝卜？
而且一点苹果味都没有。

scripts.text:
-Shay got all upset and threw something sticky and smelly.
The pie left Shay's palm and landed square in your face. -
scripts.translation:
- 谢伊气得抓起一团黏糊糊、臭烘烘的东西扔了过来。
派脱手飞出，不偏不倚地糊在你的脸上。 -

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Oops.. umph.. hmph...
Phew... sigh...
...........

[Shay]
S..Sorry. Aello told me to help you but..
.......
I couldn't help myself.
scripts.translation:
对……对不起。艾洛叫我帮你，可是……
……
我没忍住。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Ha.. there is a cat named BK among the Cat Merchants.
He might have the information you want.
... Go.. meet BK.
scripts.translation:
哈……猫商人里有只叫 BK 的猫。
它可能知道你想打听的事。
……去找 BK 吧。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
And if he ignores you, tell him that ^4d4dffShay's special drink will be delivered^000000.
scripts.translation: 要是它不理你，就告诉它：^4d4dff谢伊的特调饮料马上送到^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
You can find the Cat Merchants outside of the gate.
They seem like a small group of wanders.
You'll see their tent southeast from the gate.
scripts.translation:
猫商人就在城门外。
看起来是一小群四处漂泊的人。
城门东南边有他们的帐篷。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
BK is the one that holds information around there.
He will be able to help you.
scripts.translation:
BK 是那边的情报通。
它应该能帮你。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
You say BK said that?
So it is...
I did think Ahat was beautiful than normal.
scripts.translation:
你说 BK 是这么讲的？原来如此……
我也觉得阿哈特长得比一般人英俊。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
But according to the Saphas' stories I hear in this pub
they all have a different version of Ahat.
scripts.translation:
不过，根据我在酒馆里听到的萨法族人传闻，
他们对阿哈特的描述各不相同。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
But BK said Ahat isn't a Sapha?
That only means that its not the looks that is different but may be completely a different race.
scripts.translation:
可是 BK 说阿哈特不是萨法族人？
那就不是外表不同，而是他根本属于另一个种族。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
We can only investigate.
They say he came from the crack so let's investigate the crack.
scripts.translation:
我们只能继续调查。
听说他来自裂缝，那就去查查裂缝吧。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
But there is a crack here too?
..Too many ill-fates.
Bit sorrowful.
scripts.translation:
可这里也有一道裂缝？
……倒霉事真多。
想想还有点难过。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
It is always better to go to the site.
Because it is difficult to meet the minister.
scripts.translation:
最好亲自去现场看看。
毕竟那位大臣可不容易见到。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
The crack here must have been created when the crack in Morocc appeared.
If he did it.
scripts.translation:
这里的裂缝应该和梦罗克那道裂缝同时出现。
如果真是他造成的话。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
You'll find a crack northeast from El Dicastes.
Try investigating there.
scripts.translation:
埃尔迪卡斯特东北方有一道裂缝。
去那里调查看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Any luck?
scripts.translation: 有进展吗？

scripts.text: - You show the {0} you collected from near the crack.-
scripts.translation: - 你拿出在裂缝附近收集到的{0}。 -

scripts.text:
- You do not have the item needed for the quest. Case3
If your quest item was destroyed, request help from GM.-
scripts.translation:
- 缺少任务所需的物品。案件3
如果任务物品已损毁，请联系游戏管理员。 -

scripts.text:
[Shay]
.. I didn't expect this.
Then who is Ahat..?
...I smell something fishy.
scripts.translation:
……我没想到会是这样。
那阿哈特究竟是谁？
……总觉得事情不对劲。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I don't know since I haven't seen Ahat in person but
we must find out what all this means.
scripts.translation:
我还没亲眼见过阿哈特，所以也不清楚。
不过，我们得弄明白这一切代表什么。

scripts.text: Do you trust BK?
scripts.translation: 你相信 BK 吗？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
At least BK doesn't lie.
The BK I know never lies.
Why are these found near the crack?
Why was Ahat near the crack..
scripts.translation:
至少 BK 不会撒谎。
我认识的 BK 从来不说谎。
为什么这些东西会出现在裂缝附近？
阿哈特为什么也在裂缝附近……

scripts.text: Do you want to meet in person?
scripts.translation: 你想亲自见见他吗？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
You can't just waltz in him.
It's even harder for outsiders like us to meet him.
Hm...
scripts.translation:
你不能就这么闯进去。
像我们这样的外来者想见他就更难了。
嗯……

scripts.text:
[Shay]
We can try collected exploit certifications.
Those who did great deeds get the opportunity to meet the minister.
scripts.translation:
我们可以试着收集功勋证明。
立下大功的人才有机会见大臣。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
The Cat Merchants are also collected exploit certifications. They want to meet the minister in person so they can negotiate business.
scripts.translation: 猫商人也在收集功勋证明。他们想亲自见大臣，好跟他谈生意。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
You can receive exploit certifications from handling requests throughout the city.
If you want to meet the minister Ahat...
scripts.translation:
在城里完成委托就能拿到功勋证明。
如果你想见大臣阿哈特……

scripts.text:
[Shay]
You'll need at least ^4d4dff3 exploit certifications^000000.
Go ^4d4dffask around in Diel^000000 for more information.
scripts.translation:
你至少需要^4d4dff3张功勋证明^000000。
去^4d4dff迪尔四处打听^000000更多消息。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Sapha that registers adventurers in Diel.
Was his name ^4d4dffRhawyne^000000. Ask him.
scripts.translation:
负责在迪尔给冒险者登记的萨法族人，
名字好像是^4d4dff拉温^000000。去问问他。

scripts.text: Don't you have any exploit certification of Sapha?
scripts.translation: 你没有萨法族的功勋证明吗？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
................
Do you think I'm that free?
I'm not the one receiving request, I'm the one that makes the requests!!
scripts.translation:
………………
你以为我那么闲吗？
我是发布委托的人，不是接委托的人！！

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Tsk.
First, think of what you have to do.
Meet Ahat by collecting exploit certifications.
And then find doubt what is the relationship between him and the crack.
scripts.translation:
啧。
先想想自己该做什么。
收集功勋证明去见阿哈特，
之后再查清他和裂缝之间的关系。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Start with collecting exploit certifications.
You'll need at least 3 certifications to meet the minister.
scripts.translation:
先收集功勋证明吧。
至少要有3张才能见大臣。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Once you have your certifications, go make a request to meet the minister at the Adventurer's reception desk in Diel.
Rhawyne will help you.
scripts.translation:
拿到证明后，去迪尔的冒险者接待处申请面见大臣。
拉温会帮你办理。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
So.. you got permitted?
I'm also curious who this Ahat character is.
scripts.translation:
所以……你拿到许可了？
我也很好奇阿哈特到底是什么样的人。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Good. I'll prepare some food until you come back.
I just found this amazing chocolate recipe a few days ago.
scripts.translation:
很好。我趁你回来前准备些吃的。
几天前我刚发现一个很棒的巧克力食谱。

scripts.text: Oh..no..

[Shay]
When I was in Morocc.
A colleague from the guild used to make chocolate stuff you see?
I thought it would be simple since he was making it.
scripts.translation:
我在梦罗克时，公会里有位同事经常做巧克力点心。
我想这应该不难，毕竟他都做得出来。
所以……

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Wait till you taste it.
Now, get going.
scripts.translation:
等你尝过就知道了。
现在，快去吧。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
How was the minister?
scripts.translation: 大臣怎么样？

scripts.text: Strange.
scripts.translation: 很奇怪。

scripts.text: ..Beautiful...

[Shay]
So.. how strange.
..was it bad or good?
No, that isn't important. Try to remember what you were there for.
scripts.translation:
所以……有多奇怪？
是好是坏？
算了，那不重要。记住你去见他的目的。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Huh? Really?
You can tell the beauty even if the race is different.
Do you job instead of dreaming about his appearance.
scripts.translation:
哈？真的？
就算种族不同，也能看出他很美吗？
别光顾着幻想他的样子，去做正事。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Hmm...
Clearing the crack area?
Sounds weird.
Something smells fishy.
scripts.translation:
嗯……
清理裂缝附近？
听起来不太对劲。
总觉得有蹊跷。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Don't forget to bring back evidence.
And to pretend you are hypnotized.
Good. This is our secret.
scripts.translation:
别忘了带回证据。
还要假装自己受了催眠。
很好，这是我们之间的秘密。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Funny how things come about.
But you really are talkative.
You are telling me everything. Tsk.
scripts.translation:
事情的发展真有意思。
不过你还真健谈，什么都告诉我了。啧。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Did you know?
There is another skillful Jarute.
Name is HesLanta.
scripts.translation:
你知道吗？
还有一位很有本事的贾鲁特，
名叫赫斯兰塔。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
He sometimes come back and shares his stories.
But I think he also has a story to tell.
scripts.translation:
他有时会回来讲讲自己的经历。
不过我觉得他自己也有故事。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
It's only a thought but
It might be good to talk to those near Ahat too.
scripts.translation:
我只是随口一提，
或许也可以跟阿哈特身边的人聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
How about talking to the Jarute named HesLanta?
You don't have nothing to lose, anyway.
scripts.translation:
去和叫赫斯兰塔的贾鲁特聊聊，怎么样？
反正也没什么损失。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Why are you here again?
Are you working?
scripts.translation:
怎么又来了？
你在工作吗？

scripts.text: Mission completed!
scripts.translation: 委托完成！

scripts.text: Came to thank you.
scripts.translation: 我来谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Really?
Good for you.
.....
Mission. Haven't heard that word for ages.
scripts.translation:
真的吗？真不错。
……
“委托”……好久没听到这个词了。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Now go.
I'm busy.
New ingredients are coming in today.
Go now.
scripts.translation:
快走吧，我很忙。
今天会有新食材送来。快去。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
If you are that grateful, each all my new cuisines till the last bite.
scripts.translation: 你要是真这么感激，就把我新做的菜全吃完，一口都不剩。

scripts.text: Ah, that is um...
scripts.translation: 啊，那个……

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Huh? Get lost.
Ungrateful....
scripts.translation:
哈？走开。
真不知感恩……

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What do you want?
scripts.translation: 你想要什么？

scripts.text: Tell me about yourself
scripts.translation: 说说你自己

scripts.text: About Sapha
scripts.translation: 关于萨法族

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Me?
Didn't I tell you before?
scripts.translation:
我？
我之前不是告诉过你吗？

scripts.text: Nope..
scripts.translation: 没有……

scripts.text:
[Shay]
No, I told you my story before.
But since you have bad memory, I'll tell you again.
scripts.translation:
我讲过自己的故事了。
不过你记性不好，我就再说一遍吧。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Hmm. Then should I tell you the story on how I settled here?
The first to apply to expedite here
where the Assassins.
scripts.translation:
嗯……要我讲讲自己是怎么在这里定居的吗？
最早申请来这里探路的，是刺客。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I was one of them.
That is how I got to reach this place before anyone else did
And that is how the base of the expedition camp was built.
scripts.translation:
我就是他们中的一员。
所以我比任何人都先到这里，远征营地的基地也由此建成。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
But you know.
I thought I'd return to my hometown and retire.
But El Dicastes contacted me.
scripts.translation: 不过啊……我本想回老家退休，没想到埃尔迪卡斯特联系了我。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
They requested if I could open a place for us outsides to feel comfortable with.
They also were considerate enough to build it in Midgard style.
scripts.translation:
他们想让我开一家店，让我们这些外来者也有个舒服的落脚处。
他们还特地按米德加尔特风格建造，挺周到的。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
So the framework and style,
architect was brought in..
and then I found myself managing the whole project?
scripts.translation:
于是定下了店面的框架和风格，请来建筑师……
结果我发现自己竟成了整个项目的负责人？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
And...
that is how I got here.
I've been here ever since!
scripts.translation:
然后……我就这么来到这里。
从那以后一直待到现在！

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I don't remember what my original job was.
Little rusty on the Katar, I guess...
scripts.translation:
我都不记得原来的职业是什么了。
拳刃大概也用得有些生疏了……

scripts.text:
Shay suddenly has a lonely expression and sighs deeply about his situation.
Looks very tired.
scripts.translation:
谢伊忽然露出落寞的神情，深深叹了口气。
看起来疲惫极了。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Sapha?
You are surrounded by Saphas.
......
scripts.translation:
萨法族？
你周围不都是萨法族人吗？
……

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What are you asking me?
Just ask any Sapha passing by.
Ask 'what are you'.
scripts.translation:
你问我做什么？
随便找个路过的萨法族人问问就好。
问他们“你们是什么人”。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What...
I'm not that busy but don't bother me too much.
scripts.translation: 怎么了……我是不算太忙，但也别太烦我。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What did you bring here now?
.........
What? No?
scripts.translation:
你这次带什么来了？
……
什么？没带？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Tsk.... boring.
scripts.translation: 啧……真无聊。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Why is strawberry chocolate so difficult to make?
Why is my chocolate falling apart?
scripts.translation:
为什么草莓巧克力这么难做？
我的巧克力怎么老是碎掉？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Also this chocolate pie.
How do I bake it just the right golden color?
Why can't it be white or black?
It isn't the pie that is important. It's the chocolate that is.
scripts.translation:
还有这个巧克力派。
怎么才能烤出恰到好处的金黄色？
为什么不能是白色或黑色？
重点不在派皮，关键是巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
How did my colleague make this?!
............
...Do girls like this?
scripts.translation:
我那位同事到底是怎么做出来的？！
…………
……女孩子会喜欢这个吗？

scripts.text: They normally do like homemade chocolate.
scripts.translation: 女孩子通常喜欢自制巧克力。

scripts.text: No. only aliens.
scripts.translation: 不，只有外星人才喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I see.
So...
Are you married?
scripts.translation:
我明白了。
那么……你结婚了吗？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
You're alone, right?
....
Sorry.
We're in the same boat.
scripts.translation:
你是一个人吧？
……
抱歉，我们同病相怜。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Suit yourself.
scripts.translation: 随你便。
（听不懂的话语）

scripts.text: Cannot communicate with him.
scripts.translation: 无法与他交流。

scripts.text:
[Knit]
Welcome, human.
I'm finally used to meeting other races like you.
scripts.translation:
欢迎，人类。
我终于习惯和你们这些其他种族打交道了。

scripts.text: Are there races other than humans?
scripts.translation: 除了人类，还有其他种族吗？

scripts.text: What are you doing?
scripts.translation: 你在做什么？

scripts.text:
[Knit]
There were Rapine before you came.
And of course there are still.
But they are over the Kamidal mountains.
scripts.translation: 你来之前，附近就有拉菲尼族。现在当然也还有，不过他们住在卡米达尔山脉那边。

scripts.text:
[Knit]
And then the cats..
Ah, did you see the group of cats in front of the castle?
They are really soft and cuddly unlike us.
scripts.translation:
还有猫族……
你看到城堡前那群猫了吗？
它们不像我们，摸起来又软又舒服。

scripts.text:
[Knit]
And especially their ear and tail!!
scripts.translation: 尤其是它们的耳朵和尾巴！！

scripts.text: Have you seen this man?
scripts.translation: 你见过这个人吗？

scripts.text:
[Knit]
Eh? Huh?
Man? Human male?
A human male with cat ears?
Never heard such thing..
scripts.translation:
咦？什么？
男人？人类男性？
长着猫耳的人类男性？
没听说过这种事……

scripts.text:
[Knit]
Humans are amazing!
Didn't even think of that...!
.....
scripts.translation:
人类真厉害！
我连这种事都没想过……！
……

scripts.text:
[Knit]
But they are really lovely.
Those cute cats..
scripts.translation:
不过它们真的很可爱。
那些可爱的猫……

scripts.text:
[Knit]
But Ahat is also loveable even for a Sapha.
....if my hair is like a dry winter tree..
Ahat's hair is like new sprouts in early spring.....
scripts.translation:
不过，阿哈特连萨法族人看了都会喜欢……
……我的头发就像寒冬里的枯树，
阿哈特的头发却像早春的新芽……

scripts.text:
[Knit]
I can't believe how he does his work for Dicastes
and still maintain such great hair.
I can almost see a glow.
scripts.translation:
真不敢相信，他为迪卡斯特工作那么忙，
还能把头发打理得这么好。
简直像在发光。

scripts.text:
[Knit]
Ah.....his skin is divine.
But he never comes out from his office high up in Dicastes Diel.
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
啊……他的皮肤真是完美无瑕。
可他总待在迪尔高处的办公室里，从不出来。

scripts.text:
[Knit]
But I guess it would be better for Ahat's complexion...
to stay warm and safe like a crystal bird in Diel instead of being out in the winter weather!
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
不过对阿哈特的皮肤来说，
待在迪尔温暖安全的地方，像水晶鸟一样，总比在寒冬里受冻好吧！

scripts.text:
- Continues to talk about Ahat.
Don't think I'll get any more information. -
scripts.translation:
- 他继续谈论阿哈特。
看来也问不出更多情报了。-

scripts.text:
[Knit]
They are really lovely.
Those cute cats..
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
那些猫真可爱啊。

scripts.text:
[Knit]
But Ahat is also loveable even for a Sapha.
....if my hair is like a dry winter tree..
Ahat's hair is like new sprouts in early spring.....
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
不过，连萨法人都会觉得阿哈特很可爱。
……我的头发像冬天的枯树……
阿哈特的头发却像早春的新芽……

scripts.text:
[Knit]
Ah.. I'm so jealous, envious..
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
啊……我真嫉妒，羡慕……

scripts.text:
[Knit]
As you can see, I'm taking a walk.
I should walk from time to time to prevent myself from getting stiff.
I really don't like to get stiff.
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
如你所见，我正在散步。
得时不时走走，免得身体僵硬。
我可不喜欢僵硬。

scripts.text:
[Knit]
Don't you think cats are amazing.
I heard from where you came from, you have pets..
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
你不觉得猫很神奇吗？
听说你们那边会养宠物……

scripts.text:
[Knit]
Is it okay to raise other creatures?
Do they want that?
It's a difficult issue..
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
饲养其他生物真的好吗？
它们自己愿意吗？
这问题真难……

[皮奥姆]
（听不懂的萨法语）

scripts.text:
[Piom]
[Piom]
Phew.. I need to rest.
Huh? You're... human!
Why are you here?
scripts.translation:
[皮奥姆]
[皮奥姆]
呼……我得休息一下。
嗯？你是……人类！
为什么会在这里？

scripts.text:
[Piom]
[Piom]
As you can see, I'm taking a rest.
I like my job but it is so tiresome.
But I'm happier than when I was a Knit.
scripts.translation:
[皮奥姆]
[皮奥姆]
如你所见，我正在休息。
我喜欢这份工作，就是太累了。
不过比起当尼特时，我现在快乐多了。

scripts.text: Cannot communicate with him.
scripts.translation: 无法与他交流。

scripts.text: About a human with cat ears..
scripts.translation: 关于一个长着猫耳朵的人类……

scripts.text:
[Piom]
HAHAHAHA!!!
HAHAHAHA!!!
There are so many asking about that recently.
Is there any conflict with the Cat Merchants?
scripts.translation:
[皮奥姆]
哈哈哈哈！！！
最近好多人来打听这事。
你和猫商人之间是不是有什么冲突？

scripts.text:
[Piom]
Haha.. ... funny.
Human with cat ears. Never heard of such thing.
But you seem to be new around here.
scripts.translation:
[皮奥姆]
哈哈……真有意思。
长着猫耳朵的人类？我没听说过这种事。
不过你看起来刚来这里不久。

scripts.text:
[Piom]
Don't waste your time on something ridiculous as that
That's it! I think you are the right person.
scripts.translation:
[皮奥姆]
别把时间浪费在这么荒唐的事上。
对了！你正合适。

scripts.text:
[Piom]
The minister stays at the top of Diel
Try meeting the minister.
He is a wonderful person.
A role model to all Saphas!
scripts.translation:
[皮奥姆]
大臣住在迪尔的上层。
你去见见他吧。
他是个了不起的人，
是所有萨法人的榜样！

scripts.text:
[Piom]
You need to know about Saphas if you are staying in El Dicastes, right?
Don't spend time with a dusty Piom like me, and go meet Ahat.
You will love him.
scripts.translation:
[皮奥姆]
既然要留在艾尔迪卡斯特，你总得了解一下萨法人吧？
别把时间浪费在我这个灰头土脸的皮奥姆身上，去见阿哈特吧。
你会喜欢他的。

scripts.text:
- Continues to talk about Ahat.
Don't think I'll get any more information. -
scripts.translation:
- 他继续谈论阿哈特。
看来也问不出更多情报了。-

scripts.text:
[Piom]
Don't follow cats around
Go and meet Ahat.
He is really beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[皮奥姆]
别再跟着猫跑了，
去见阿哈特吧。
他可漂亮了。

scripts.text:
[Piom]
I can't think straight.
I didn't like working through documents the Knits do.
But then Galtens have to carry heavy weapons.
scripts.translation:
[皮奥姆]
我都想不清楚了。
我不喜欢做尼特负责的那些文书工作，
可加尔滕又得扛沉重的武器。

scripts.text:
[Piom]
The last thing I did was mine and refine Bradium
and I loved it!
And to think that my work keeps everyone healthy
is rewarding.
scripts.translation:
[皮奥姆]
我最后做的是开采和精炼魔力之石，
我特别喜欢！
想到这份工作能让大家保持健康，
就觉得很有意义。

[加尔滕]
（听不懂的萨法语）

scripts.text: Cannot communicate with him.
scripts.translation: 无法与他交流。

scripts.text:
[Galten]
Hmm...another peaceful day.
Hmm? Aren't you the outsider that came here awhile ago?
Have you come to see the training grounds?
scripts.translation:
[加尔滕]
嗯……又是平静的一天。
嗯？你就是之前来过的外乡人吧？
是来看训练场的吗？

scripts.text: About a human with cat ears..
scripts.translation: 关于一个长着猫耳朵的人类……

scripts.text:
[Galten]
Cat ears?
Is there someone like that?
Humans are like that?
scripts.translation:
[加尔滕]
猫耳朵？
真有这样的人吗？
人类都长那样吗？

scripts.text:
[Galten]
What? No?
Then why are you looking him..
Why don't you go meet Ahat instead of wasting your time.
scripts.translation:
[加尔滕]
什么？没有？
那你为什么一直找他……
别浪费时间了，去见阿哈特吧。

scripts.text:
[Galten]
Anyone that wants to be strong
should meet Ahat.
He is a very strong Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[加尔滕]
想变强的人都该去见见阿哈特。
他是非常强大的萨法人。

scripts.text:
[Galten]
He may be a Jarute working through piles of documents
but he must be hiding his power!
scripts.translation:
[加尔滕]
他虽然是贾鲁特，每天处理成堆的文书，
可一定是在隐藏实力！

scripts.text:
[Galten]
Everyone says Ahat is like a delicate spring sprout
but I don't agree!
I've never seen a stronger Sapha before.
But I don't quite understand why he didn't become a Galten...
scripts.translation:
[加尔滕]
大家都说阿哈特像娇嫩的春芽，
我可不这么认为！
我从没见过比他更强的萨法人。
不过我不明白，他为什么没成为加尔滕……

scripts.text:
- Continues to talk about Ahat.
Don't think I'll get any more information. -
scripts.translation:
- 他继续谈论阿哈特。
看来也问不出更多情报了。-

scripts.text:
[Galten]
Ahat...
He is a strong Sapha.
He may be a minister working through piles of documents
but he must be hiding his power!
scripts.translation:
[加尔滕]
阿哈特……
他是个强大的萨法人。
虽然身为大臣，每天都处理成堆的文书，
但他一定隐藏着实力！

scripts.text:
[Galten]
Everyone says Ahat is like a delicate spring sprout
but I don't agree!
I've never seen a stronger Sapha before.
But I don't quite understand why he didn't become a Galten...
scripts.translation:
[加尔滕]
大家都说阿哈特像娇嫩的春芽，
我可不这么认为！
我从没见过比他更强的萨法人。
不过我不明白，他为什么没成为加尔滕……

scripts.text:
[Galten]
Maybe he is physically strong but has a warm heart..
but you never know...
scripts.translation:
[加尔滕]

[弗雷德]

scripts.text:

We can have a chat after you are done with it.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]

scripts.text:

[{0}]

scripts.text:
[{0}]

I'm only a little tired, that's all.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没事，只是有点累而已。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Here, sit and eat this.
The cats outside gave it to me. It doesn't do much good for Saphas but I heard it's suppose to help you humans.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
来，坐下吃点这个。
这是外面的猫给我的。萨法人吃了没什么用，不过听说对你们人类有帮助。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But the injury on your leg doesn't look new. Why did you come out with a wounded leg?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不过你腿上的伤不像是新伤。腿受伤了，为什么还出来？

scripts.text:
[Frede]
I can still move around with this leg and I wanted to help the village.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
这条腿还能活动，我想为村子出一份力。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But you should stay home and recover.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但你应该留在家里休养。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
The fact is, my leg will never recover.
I can only keep my injury from getting worse.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
说实话，我的腿再也好不了了。
我只能尽量不让伤势恶化。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
But I'm grateful that I can still move around.
Ha......
When did we start to be afraid of 'death'.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
但我很庆幸自己还能走动。
哈……
我们从什么时候开始害怕“死亡”了呢？

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Saphas have never had any 'sicknesses' and we don't die unless there is a terrible accident.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
萨法人从来不会生病，除非发生严重意外，否则也不会死去。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
This is also the reason why we Saphas can maintain a perfect community.
We didn't have to be greedy.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
这也是我们萨法人能维持理想社会的原因。
我们不必贪婪。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
But suddenly we are hit with this epidemic and many Saphas have lost their loved ones ever since.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
可这场瘟疫突然袭来，从那以后，许多萨法人都失去了亲人。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
We weren't prepared for such a disaster.
It was chaos. Nobody knew what to do but watch them die.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
我们对这样的灾难毫无准备。
当时一片混乱，谁也不知道该怎么办，只能眼睁睁看着他们死去。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
It was worse for us because we never experienced death from getting old.
I also thought my ^f57d7dStill Friends^000000 would wake up one day.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
对我们来说，这更难以接受，因为我们从未经历过衰老而死。
我也曾以为我的^f57d7d挚友^000000总有一天会醒来。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
But after a while, we realized it was a sickness that led to death and started to search for a cure but the situation was out of control.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
后来我们才意识到那是一种会致命的疾病，于是开始寻找疗法，可局势已经失控。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
We are very advanced in science technology but we lack knowledge in the medical field.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
我们的科技很先进，但医学知识却很匮乏。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
A medicine was completed only after we lost many lives but it isn't enough to completely cure the sickness.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
直到失去许多生命后，我们才研制出药物，可它还不足以彻底治愈这种疾病。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
As long as I don't forget to take my Bradium, I can keep from getting any worse.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
只要记得服用魔力之石，我的病情就不会继续恶化。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
I recently did some ^f57d7drepair work in the cave next to the village^000000, but I forgot to take Bradium while I was working.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Lash]
The sweat, heavy breathing, and continuous tiredness proves that I'm a true Sapha.
And I actually enjoy it. Ha ha ha ha.
scripts.translation:
[拉什]
汗水、喘息和持续的疲惫，证明了我是真正的萨法人。
而且我还挺享受的。哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Lash]
If you'd like to tell him how I'm doing, look at my forearm. Doesn't it spell out 'Strong' on it?
scripts.translation:
[拉什]
想知道我的近况，就看看我的前臂吧。上面是不是写着“强壮”？

scripts.text:
[Lash]
Just tell him what you see!
Ha ha ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[拉什]
看到了什么就照实告诉他！
哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Lash]
Sigh......
I'm so tired...
But fatigue helps me to move forward.
scripts.translation:
[拉什]
唉……
累死我了……
不过，疲惫能让我继续前进。

scripts.text:
[Lash]
The sweat, heavy breathing, and continuous tiredness proves that I'm a true Sapha.
And I actually enjoy it. Ha ha ha ha.
scripts.translation:
[拉什]
汗水、喘息和持续的疲惫，证明了我是真正的萨法人。
而且我还挺享受的。哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Lash]
But what is your business here?
You want to share the labor and sweat?
scripts.translation:
[拉什]
不过，你来这里做什么？
想和我一起流汗干活吗？

scripts.text:
[Lash]
Hm?
Oh, you are Frede's messenger?
To bad.
I thought you were like me judging from your forearm.
scripts.translation:
[拉什]
嗯？
哦，你是弗雷德派来的信使？
真遗憾。
我还以为你和我一样，看你前臂还挺结实的。

scripts.text:
[Lash]
If you'd like to tell him how I'm doing, look at my forearm. Doesn't it spell out 'Strong' on it?
scripts.translation:
[拉什]
想知道我的近况，就看看我的前臂吧。上面是不是写着“强壮”？

scripts.text:
[Lash]
Just tell him what you see!
Ha ha ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[拉什]
看到了什么就照实告诉他！
哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Lash]
If you'd like to tell him how I'm doing, look at my forearm. Doesn't it spell out 'Strong' on it?
[Lash]
Just tell him what you see!
Ha ha ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[拉什]
想知道我的近况，就看看我的前臂吧。上面是不是写着“强壮”？
[拉什]
看到了什么就照实告诉他！
哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Lash]
Wow!!!!
You've saved me!
[Lash]
I would have perished into ashes here if it weren't for you!
scripts.translation:
[拉什]
哇！！！！
你救了我！
[拉什]
要不是你，我早就在这里化为灰烬了！

scripts.text:
[Lash]
Moan...
Is... this what they call fatigue!
Never knew I would feel this. Sob.
scripts.translation:
[拉什]
呻吟……
这……这就是他们说的疲惫吗！
没想到我也会有这种感觉。呜。

scripts.text: You give Bradium to Lash.
scripts.translation: 把魔力之石交给拉什。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Frede asked me to give you this.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
弗雷德托我把这个交给你。

scripts.text:
[Lash]
Wow!!!!
You've saved me!
scripts.translation:
[拉什]
哇！！！！
你救了我！

scripts.text:
[Lash]
I would have perished into ashes here if it weren't for you!
scripts.translation:
[拉什]
要不是你，我早就在这里化为灰烬了！

scripts.text:
[Lash]
Ha ha ha!!
You are my savior!
Our friendship will last forever regardless of race!
scripts.translation:
[拉什]
哈哈哈！！
你是我的救命恩人！
无论种族如何，我们的友谊都长存！

[拉什]
（听不懂的萨法语）

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
Outsiders are prohibited here.
If you have come here by mistake, please find your way out now.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
禁止外人进入。
如果你误入此地，请立刻离开。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
Outsiders are prohibited here.
If you have come here by mistake, please find your way out now.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
禁止外人进入。
如果你误入此地，请立刻离开。

scripts.text: I came on behalf of Frede.
scripts.translation: 我是受弗雷德委托来的。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
I didn't know. Excuse me.
What did he ask you to do?
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
原来如此，抱歉。
他托你来做什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He asked me to deliver Bradium to his friends working in the cave outside the village.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他让我把魔力之石送给在村外洞穴工作的朋友们。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
Oh no. I don't have any portable Bradium because of insufficient supplies.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
糟了，补给不足，我这里没有便携式魔力之石。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
I will only be able to get the Bradium that is being refined now in a few days. We let Pioms returning from outside work stay and rest in the village.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
现在正在精炼的魔力之石还要几天才能完成。我们会让从外面工作回来的皮奥姆留在村里休息。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
But I see they haven't returned yet.
They must be out of Bradium by now.
This isn't good.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
可是他们到现在还没回来。
魔力之石应该已经用完了。
这下糟了。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
Worst case, they wouldn't come back to the village at all.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
最坏的情况是，他们可能根本回不了村子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is there another way?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
还有别的办法吗？

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
It takes a lot of time to refine a large Bradium mineral but small pieces of Bradium will be quick.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
精炼一整块大型魔力之石需要很久，但精炼小块的就快多了。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
Bradium mineral can be collected anywhere in this area but the effectiveness of refined pieces is low.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
这片区域到处都能采到魔力之石矿，但精炼后的小块效果较弱。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
You can easily collect ^f57d7dpieces of Bradium from monsters nearby^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
附近的魔物身上很容易取得^f57d7d魔力之石碎片^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
About ^f57d7d30 pieces of Bradium^000000 will be enough to share with 6 people.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
大约^f57d7d30块魔力之石碎片^000000，就够分给6个人了。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
You've brought back the Bradium.
I've been waiting for the Galtens to return because I'm not accustomed to battle since I'm Venknick. Thank you very much.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
你把魔力之石带回来了。
我不擅长战斗，因为我是文克尼克，所以一直在等加尔滕回来。太感谢你了。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
Handwork is much faster to refine pieces of Bradium instead of using a machine. I will only need two hours to finish.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
手工精炼魔力之石碎片比用机器快得多。我只要两个小时就能做好。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
Please go rest while I get to work.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
我开始工作了，你先去休息吧。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
Bradium mineral can be collected anywhere in this area but the effectiveness of refined pieces is low.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
这片区域到处都能采到魔力之石矿，但精炼后的小块效果较弱。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
You can easily collect ^f57d7dpieces of Bradium from monsters nearby^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
附近的魔物身上很容易取得^f57d7d魔力之石碎片^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
About ^f57d7d30 pieces of Bradium^000000 will be enough to share with 6 people.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
大约^f57d7d30块魔力之石碎片^000000，就够分给6个人了。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
I did it!
I was a bit nervous because it has been a long time since I did manual work but I think I did a good job.
Please take these to them.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
做好了！
我很久没做手工活，刚才有点紧张，不过我觉得做得不错。
请把这些带给他们。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
I'm still working on it so please rest a little more.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
我还在做，请再休息一会儿。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
Saphas cannot live unless we consume Bradium continuously.
That is why we needed spaces for us to inject Bradium all over the village.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
萨法人必须持续摄取魔力之石才能生存。
所以我们在村子各处设置了补充魔力之石的地方。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
But those working outside of the village cannot return often to refill their Bradium so we provide Bradium that is portable.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
在村外工作的人没法经常回来补充魔力之石，所以我们会给他们便携式的魔力之石。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
But there was a problem with the Bradium mining in the Manuk area recently and we have a shortage of supplies. We don't have enough to give out.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
不过最近马努克地区的魔力之石开采出了问题，补给短缺，库存不够发放。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
That is why many Pioms working in the outskirts of the village return for more supplies,
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
所以许多在村子外围工作的皮奥姆不得不频繁回来领取补给，

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
and the time spent on transportation is what is slowing down work.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
运输耗费的时间拖慢了工作进度。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
To tell you the truth, transportation time doesn't make much difference but it adds up in the end.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
说实话，每趟运输花不了太多时间，但累积起来就很可观了。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
We call this the ^f57d7dCreamy Effect^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
我们把这种现象称为^f57d7d克瑞米效应^000000。

[布伊]
（听不懂的萨法语）

scripts.text:
[Maha]
But I do think the Sapha race is overly kind, almost unnaturally.
Guess it'll be fine.
scripts.translation:
[玛哈]
不过我总觉得萨法人善良得有些过头了，简直不太自然。
应该没事吧。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
There is nothing strange!
I'd love to be like you and respected by many people.
scripts.translation:
[本]
没什么奇怪的！
我也想像你一样受大家尊敬。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
I can also visit the Sapha if I work well here, can't I?
scripts.translation:
[本]
只要我在这里好好工作，也能去拜访萨法人，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Hmm. Hey, Maha,
what do you think?
Why do you think he is here?
scripts.translation:
[本]
嗯。嘿，玛哈，
你怎么看？
你觉得他为什么会在这里？

scripts.text:
[Maha]
Don't know. Not interested.
scripts.translation:
[玛哈]
不知道，也不感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Don't you find that guy strange?
I've never seen his race before I joined the expedition.
scripts.translation:
[本]
你不觉得那家伙很奇怪吗？
加入探险队之前，我从没见过他这样的种族。

scripts.text:
[Maha]
Ah. Really?
Then it's only you.
There must be a reason why he is here.
scripts.translation:
[玛哈]
啊，是吗？
看来就你一个人这么觉得。
他会在这里肯定有原因。

scripts.text:
[Maha]
They may make an announcement soon.
All we need to do is wait for the announcement.
It will give us the answers.
scripts.translation:
[玛哈]
他们很快就会发布公告。
我们只要等公告就行。
到时候答案自然会揭晓。

scripts.text: What is it?
scripts.translation: 怎么了？

scripts.text: Stay silent and listen.
scripts.translation: 保持安静，继续听。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Hmm...
That can be true but aren't you thinking too much?
scripts.translation:
[本]
嗯……
也许有道理，不过你是不是想太多了？

scripts.text:
[Maha]
I don't like to get into trouble.
I only follow orders.
Besides, there is nothing out of the ordinary.
scripts.translation:
[玛哈]
我不想惹麻烦。
我只服从命令。
再说，也没什么异常。

scripts.text:
[Maha]
From what I can tell
That tree-like giant race called Sapha are kind.
There won't be any trouble. Relax.
scripts.translation:
[玛哈]
据我所知，那个像树一样的巨人种族萨法人很友善。
不会有什么麻烦的，放心吧。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Huh? Did you hear us?
Nothing really or maybe something...
So...
scripts.translation:
[本]
咦？你听见我们说话了？
没什么大事……也可能有点事……
总之……

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Research members dispatched to Manuk just came back.
But...
scripts.translation:
[本]
派去马努克的研究队员刚回来。
不过……

scripts.text: But?
scripts.translation: 怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Well... they came back with a Manuk messenger!
...Sapha of Manuk.
scripts.translation:
[本]
他们带回了一位马努克的信使！
……一位马努克萨法人。

scripts.text: Where is he?!
scripts.translation: 他在哪儿？！

scripts.text: Is this top secret information?!
scripts.translation: 这是最高机密吗？！

scripts.text:
[Ben]
He's in the command center right now.
We should go there.
scripts.translation:
[本]
他现在就在指挥中心。
我们过去吧。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Excuse me.
There was no order to restrict or keep it a secret.
And it looks like they are making an official visit.
scripts.translation:
[本]
抱歉。
没有下令限制探视或保密。
看起来他们是在进行正式访问。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
We might be able to know something if we go to the command center now
Try seeing ^4d4dffAello^000000.
scripts.translation:
[本]
现在去指挥中心也许能打听到些情况。
去找^4d4dff艾洛^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
Ah, you. Good timing.
I have something urgent to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
啊，是你。来得正好。
有件急事要告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
Do you happen to know that a messenger from Manuk is here?
Not a big secret but..
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
你知道有位马努克的信使来了吗？
这不算什么秘密，不过……

scripts.text:
[Aello]
The Sapha from Manuk wants to talk to you.
Agiff says anyone of from the expedition can meet him but..
I think someone with more experience should go.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
那位来自马努克的萨法人想和你谈谈。
阿吉夫说远征队里谁都可以去见他，不过……
我觉得还是派个经验丰富的人去比较好。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
I know your abilities
and trust you.
The delegation is in the room at the right on the second floor.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
我了解你的本领，也信任你。
代表团在二楼右侧的房间里。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
There will be a guard standing in front
just tell him you got authorization.
He is interested in humans, so try to be courteous while talking to him.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
门口会有卫兵。告诉他你已获准拜访即可。
他对人类很感兴趣，交谈时记得保持礼貌。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
It's the room at the right on the second floor.
There is a guard in front of the room.
He'll let you pass if you tell him you have authorization.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
房间在二楼右侧，门口有卫兵。
告诉他你已获准拜访，他就会放你进去。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
Try not to give unnecessary information
and only do small talk.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
尽量别透露不必要的信息，只聊些家常。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
I knew I could count on you.
You're activities will help us tremendously in expanding our territory.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
我就知道可以信任你。
你的行动会大大帮助我们拓展领地。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
I am only interested in the most skillful
and trustworthy person among the Ash-Vacuum expedition.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
在阿什·真空远征队里，我只对最能干、最值得信赖的人感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
But.. you are a new face around here.
Hmm... sorry but you won't do.
You'll have to get yourself familiar with this camp first.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
不过，你是个新面孔。
嗯……抱歉，你还不行。
得先熟悉一下营地才行。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Sorry, but this room is currently restricted from visitors.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
抱歉，这个房间目前谢绝访客。

scripts.text: I have authorization.
scripts.translation: 我有通行许可。

scripts.text: Is that so.
scripts.translation: 是吗？

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
You do?
What is your name.
Thank you.
So you are {0}.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
您有许可？
请问您的名字是？
谢谢。原来您就是{0}。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
You may go in now.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
现在可以进去了。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
You mustn't enter without Aello's permission.
No exceptions.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
未经艾洛许可不得进入。
没有例外。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
You're back.
Are you acquainted with the Sapha messenger now?
We have high expectations from you.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
您回来了。
现在认识那位萨法信使了吗？
我们对您寄予厚望。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Sorry.
This room is restricted from visitors.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
抱歉，此房间谢绝访客。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Let's continue..
Although the details are already settled.
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
我们继续吧……
虽然细节已经敲定了。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Ah, yes.
Where was I?
Ah, yes.
El Dicastes!
El Dicastes is the capital city of Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
啊，是的。
我说到哪儿了？
对了，艾尔迪卡斯特！
艾尔迪卡斯特是萨法的首都。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
A city like a sparkling jewel in white snow.
Manuk was originally a village created to mine Bradium.
El Dicastes has now grown to be the Sapha home ground.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
那是一座宛如白雪中闪耀宝石的城市。
马努克最初只是为开采魔力之石而建立的村庄。
如今，艾尔迪卡斯特已成为萨法族的家园。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Ravail holds all authority in El Dicastes
and makes decisions on reports from Manuk.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
拉维尔掌管艾尔迪卡斯特的一切事务，
并根据马努克送来的报告做出决定。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Kind race born from a world other than ours
we are grateful for your kindness
in helping and cooperating with us.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
你们来自另一个世界，是善良的种族。
感谢你们一路以来的帮助与合作。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Ravail, representative of Sapha
would like to invite humans to El Dicastes,
Sapha's capital city.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
萨法代表拉维尔想邀请人类前往萨法首都艾尔迪卡斯特。

scripts.text: Invite? Visit? City?!
scripts.translation: 邀请？参观？城市？！

scripts.text: What is that suppose to mean, Hound?
scripts.translation: 猎犬，这是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Just as he said.
Our expedition team has helped the Saphas for some time.
Collect Bradium for their survival or
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
他说的没错。
我们的远征队已经帮助萨法人一段时间了，比如为他们的生存收集魔力之石，或是……

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Eliminate vicious beasts that threaten them.
.. ......
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
消灭威胁他们的凶猛野兽。
……

scripts.text:
[Hound]
So they have given us an official invitation to visit their capital city in return.
That is why I've been selecting expedition members to send to El Dicastes, the capital city of Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
作为回报，他们正式邀请我们访问首都。
所以我一直在挑选远征队成员，派他们前往萨法首都艾尔迪卡斯特。

scripts.text: ..You mean..
scripts.translation: ……你的意思是……

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Yes.
That is what he meant.
Agiff also approved before he left.
{0}, you are invited.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
没错，他就是这个意思。
阿吉夫离开前也批准了。
{0}，你受邀了。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
You are kind and respect others
polite and trustworthy and most of all, fun in character.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
你为人善良，尊重他人，
彬彬有礼又值得信赖，
而且性格风趣。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
You are perfect. Ravail will approve too.
That is why I'm here.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
你再合适不过了，拉维尔也会同意的。
我正是为此而来。

scripts.text: Never would have imagined.
scripts.translation: 真没想到会这样。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Shouldn't you already be used to the unexpected by now?
Come on... you're not a rookie.. haha.
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
你现在应该早就习惯这种意外了吧？
拜托……你又不是新人……哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
If you are going to leave, better be now.
Come back to me once you are ready to leave.
I will let you know your mission.
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
如果要出发，最好现在就动身。
准备好后回来找我，
我会告诉你这趟的任务。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
First go to Manuk and meet General Guard Avalanche.
Avalanche will be heavily armed because he is Galten.
You can't miss him.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
先去马努克见卫兵队长雪崩。
他是加尔滕，会穿戴全副装备，很容易认出来。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Once you tell Avalanche that you are a guest of the city, he will let you pass the path to El Dicastes.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
告诉雪崩你是受邀来城里的客人，他就会放你通过通往艾尔迪卡斯特的道路。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
You cannot go pass without his approval so make sure you get his permission.
He will let you pass with my recommendations.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
没有他的批准，你无法通过，所以一定要取得许可。
他会看在我的推荐上放你通行。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
I'm a little excited.
on what our meeting will bring in the future.
Only hope it won't be like a blizzard in the middle of the night.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
我有些期待这次会面会为未来带来什么。
只希望不会像深夜的暴风雪那样。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
My name is Hound.
Are you here by Aello's request?
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
我叫猎犬。
你是应艾洛的要求来的吗？

scripts.text: Yes. He told me to meet the Sapha.
scripts.translation: 是的。他让我来见那位萨法人。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Okay. You should be able to talk to him, right?
Shall we start with introducing ourselves?
This is...
{0}...
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
好，那你应该能和他交谈了。
我们先互相介绍一下吧？
这位是……
{0}……

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
My name is Vyhannus.
{0}..?
Glad to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
我叫维汉努斯。
你是{0}……？
很高兴认识你。

scripts.text: Same here.
scripts.translation: 我也很高兴认识你。

scripts.text: A tree monster!
scripts.translation: 一只树形魔物！

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Amazing.
Like with Hound, that ring you humans made...
is like a ring of wisdom.
[Vyhannus]
Shall we skip to the point?
The reason why I am here...
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
真令人惊叹。
和猎犬一样，你们人类制作的戒指……
就像智慧之戒。
[维汉努斯]
我们直接说正事吧？
我这次来的原因……

scripts.text:
[Hound]
What are you saying?
That was rude!
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
你说什么呢？太失礼了！

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Oh. Monster?
That is something new.
Hound. I'm fine. You humans are amusing.
scripts.translation:

哦，魔物？
这倒是头一回听说。
猎犬，我没事。你们人类真有意思。

Shall we skip to the point?
The reason why I am here...

我们直接说正事吧？
我这次来的原因……

scripts.text:

Excuse me, hold on a second.
scripts.translation:
[某人的声音]
打扰一下，请稍等。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Commander!
You've come at such short notice.
Is there a situation?
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
指挥官！
您怎么突然来了？
出什么事了吗？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Huh? Nothing.
Was there anything.
You said you wanted to send a trustworthy person, right?
I wanted to see the person Aello chosen to send.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嗯？没什么事。
你刚才说想派个可靠的人去吧？
我想亲眼看看艾洛选的人。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hm... Ah.
Is it you?
I see, just as Aello explained.
Well, I think we are in good hands if it is you.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嗯……啊。
是你啊？
看来正如艾洛所说。
交给你办，我就放心了。

scripts.text: What are you implying?
scripts.translation: 你这话是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
So... It's like this.
Both Saphas and humans had many differences in the past.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
事情是这样的。
过去，萨法人和人类之间有许多隔阂。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
We've worried about becoming enemies with your race after you've suddenly appeared
and were afraid of your abilities.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
你们突然出现时，我们担心会与你们为敌，
也害怕你们的力量。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
But you have respected us Saphas
and helped Manuk with many deeds.
We've come to recognize humans as good people.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
但你们尊重萨法人，还为马努克做了许多事。
我们逐渐认识到人类是友善的。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Yes, we made efforts.
We also tried to keep a neutral attitude.
Because it is always better to strengthen amnity as a third party then taking sides in a conflict.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
没错，我们做了不少努力。
也尽量保持中立。
毕竟在冲突中，以第三方身份增进友好，总比选边站更好。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Well..
Not totally wrong, I guess...
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
嗯……
我想也不算错……

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
(Vyhannus smiles)
We have told Ravail about you humans.
Ravail is the highest elder of glorious ^4d4dffEl Dicastes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
（维汉努斯微笑）
我们已经向拉维尔介绍过人类了。
拉维尔是辉煌的^4d4dff艾尔迪卡斯特^000000最高长老。

scripts.text: El Dicastes?
scripts.translation: 艾尔迪卡斯特？

scripts.text: Ravail?
scripts.translation: 拉维尔？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Ah, sorry for interrupting.
I have to go now.
Hound, I approve.
I think he will do just fine.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
啊，抱歉打断你们。
我得先走了。
猎犬，我批准这件事。
我觉得他能胜任。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Then it's settled with him.
And... ah yes, you.
Please go meet the inspector in the next room after this.
Got it?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
那就这么定了。
还有……对了，你。
谈完之后去隔壁房间见检查员。
明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I'm leaving now.
Vyhannus? I'll come by to see you again.
And you should ^4d4dffmeet Inspector Doha after talking with Vyhannus^000000.
Then bye everyone.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我先走了。
维汉努斯，改天再来看你。
和维汉努斯谈完后，记得^4d4dff去见检查员道哈^000000。
各位，再见。

scripts.text:
Commander Hibba Agip quickly left the room after saying what he wanted to say.
First, let's listen to Vyhannus's story.

指挥官希巴·阿吉普交代完事情，便匆匆离开了房间。
先听听维汉努斯怎么说吧。

Your commander is like the wind.
We have someone like that in Manuk, too.

scripts.translation:

你们的指挥官就像风一样迅捷。
马努克也有这样的人。
他叫加尔滕，动作快得让你感觉不到盔甲的重量。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Avalanche will be at the Manuk Operations building.
Once he approves, you can use the tunnel that leads to the capital city.
The tunnel might be a little scary.
But I'm sure you will reach the end of it since you are strong.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
雪崩会在马努克的作战总部。
得到他的许可后，你就能走隧道前往首都。
隧道可能有点吓人，不过我相信你足够强大，一定能走到尽头。

scripts.text:

Oh, the tunnel?
It was originally a mineral mine.
But we found ourselves on the opposite side while mining away.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
你问隧道？
它原本是矿坑。
我们不断开采，最后竟发现自己挖到了山的另一侧。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
We found better mines afterwards and that is how Manuk came about.
The tunnel is reorganized with paths between the capital city and Manuk.
scripts.translation:
[维汉努斯]
后来我们找到了更好的矿脉，马努克也因此建立起来。
之后，人们修整了隧道，将它变成连接首都与马努克的通道。

scripts.text:

That is it.
scripts.translation:

就是这样。

You received the Light of El Dicastes.

Looks like an item made for your convenience.
scripts.translation:

你获得了艾尔迪卡斯特之光。
有了它，无论身在何处，都能随时返回迪尔。
这似乎是为了方便你特意准备的道具。

scripts.text:

Ravail seems to like you very much.
The Light of El Dicastes is convenient to use instead of moving through long tunnels.

拉维尔似乎很喜欢你。

[猎犬]
你的翻译戒指呢？
我可不想一直给你当翻译。

scripts.text:

Where is the interpreter ring?
We should create it if we don't have one.
I would like to speak in person.
scripts.translation:

翻译戒指在哪儿？
要是没有，我们就得做一个。
我想亲自和他说话。

scripts.translation:

抱歉，请你先离开。
你似乎没有得到队长或艾洛的许可。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
First thing you need to do when you reach Manuk is to meet General Guard Avalanche.
Tell Avalanche that you are the one invited by Vyhannus.
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
到了马努克，第一件事就是去见卫队长雪崩。
告诉他你是维汉努斯邀请来的。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Then you'll go through a simply process of confirmation and will be permitted to go through the tunnel to the capital city.
Passing through the tunnel is easy as long as you are polite.
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
之后只需简单确认一下，就能获准通过隧道前往首都。
只要态度有礼貌，通过隧道并不难。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
And don't forget what the captain said.
Inspector Doha is in the next room.
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
别忘了队长交代的事。
检查员道哈就在隔壁房间。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
I've just returned from Manuk from a long term dispatch
and haven't gotten any rest yet.
El Dicastes.. I will find the time to visit once your advance party settles in.
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
我刚结束长期外派，从马努克回来，还没来得及休息。
等你的先遣队在艾尔迪卡斯特安顿好，我会找时间去拜访。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
I have to take care of Vyhannus here.
We might see the day when Saphas like Vyhannus will be living with us on our continent.
scripts.translation:
[猎犬]
我得留在这里照看维汉努斯。
也许有一天，像他这样的萨法人会和我们生活在同一片大陆上。

scripts.text:
[Guard Captain Avalanche]
[Avalanche]
You are human.
What do you want here?
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 雪崩]
[雪崩]
你是人类。
来这里做什么？

scripts.text:
[Guard Captain Avalanche]
[Avalanche]
Go out of this building and straight below the mountain east from the village.
You will know where it is if you see soldiers guarding the tunnel.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 雪崩]
[雪崩]
走出这栋建筑，沿着村庄东侧的山脚向下走。
看到守卫隧道的士兵，就到地方了。

scripts.text:
[Guard Captain Avalanche]
[Avalanche]
Oh... You have the Light of El Dicastes.
it would be helpful for your travel.
scripts.translation:

[雪崩]
哦……你有艾尔迪卡斯特之光。
它会让你的旅途方便不少。

scripts.text:
[Guard Captain Avalanche]
[Avalanche]
The path to the capital city was previously a mine.
so we have reports of wild monsters appearing although the tunnel is well maintained.
scripts.translation:

[雪崩]
通往首都的路以前是矿坑。

scripts.text: I've come with Vyhannus's invitation.
scripts.translation: 我是受维汉努斯邀请来的。

Ah. Jarute Vyhannus.

[雪崩]
啊，贾鲁特·维汉努斯。
我本来觉得他最好带一名卫兵同行，不过……

scripts.text:

I guess Vyhannus had trust in you humans.
I'm fine as long as Vyhannus approved you.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 雪崩]
[雪崩]
看来维汉努斯信任你们人类。
只要是他认可的人，我就没意见。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
I authorize you to pass through to El Dicastes, the capital city.
There is a tunnel that leads to the capital city right outside this building which goes down by the east mountain range of this village.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 雪崩]
[雪崩]
我批准你前往萨法首都艾尔迪卡斯特。
这栋建筑外有一条隧道，沿着村庄东侧的山脉向下，就能通往首都。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[卫队长 雪崩]
[雪崩]
这条隧道直通首都。卡米达尔山脉实在太大，没有其他绕行路线。

scripts.text:

The tunnel is well maintained but there was a time when part of the tunnel which connects
with the lowest cave of the mountain collapsed and reports of wild monsters was received.
scripts.translation:

[雪崩]
隧道维护得很好，不过曾有一段连接山底洞穴的路塌方，之后也接到过野生魔物出没的报告。

scripts.text:

It is dangerous and can be a long journey.
That is all I have to say for now.
scripts.translation:

[雪崩]
所以我建议你们结伴同行。
那里既危险，路程也很长。
我暂时就说这些。

scripts.text:
